faq.title: Questions setters and closers ask us.

items.q: Do I need a registered business?
items.a: Yes. You work as a self-employed sales partner (commercial agent under § 84 of the German Commercial Code) and invoice us monthly. A small business registration is enough. We show you what the invoice looks like during onboarding.

items.q: Does getting started cost anything?
items.a: No. No fees, no training packages, no mandatory purchases. You need a phone, a laptop and an internet connection.

items.q: When is commission paid out?
items.a: After the customer's payment has arrived at NexAI, monthly against your invoice. The one-off commission comes with the customer's first payment, the monthly commission from the second month with every further payment for as long as the customer stays.

items.q: What does 'no clawbacks' mean?
items.a: We never reclaim commission that has been paid out. If a customer cancels, only the further monthly commission stops from the following month. If a customer never pays an invoice, however, no commission arises for that invoice either.

items.q: Can I do this on the side?
items.a: Yes. You organise your own time. The promotion criteria are weekly numbers; how and when you reach them is up to you.

items.q: Do I have to work exclusively for NexAI?
items.a: No. You may sell other products and work for other clients. We only expect you not to refer NexAI customers to a competing offer.

items.q: Where do the leads come from, and how good are they?
items.a: From public company sources, checked by us: industry, decision-maker, phone number. They are cold B2B contacts, not enquiries. What becomes of them is decided by your call.

items.q: How many appointments do I get as a closer?
items.a: As many as our setters book. We don't promise a fixed number because we can't guarantee it. You can book appointments yourself at any time; for those customers the setter + closer commission applies.

items.q: What does the product cost the customer?
items.a: Prices are individual because every agent is built differently. You get the offer logic and the exact commission rates in the intro call and in the career system PDF that arrives by email after you apply.

items.q: What happens if I don't reach the junior criteria?
items.a: Then we talk about why and decide together whether and how to continue. You receive the one-off commission for your closed deals in any case.

items.q: What does the contract look like, and how do I cancel?
items.a: A sales partner contract under German law: self-employed, no base pay, no minimum term, cancellable by either side with four weeks' notice to the end of the month. Commission claims that have already arisen remain. You receive the contract before signing and read it at your own pace.

items.q: I'm in Austria or Switzerland. Does that work?
items.a: Yes, as long as you sell remotely in German and are allowed to be self-employed in your country. The contract is governed by German law.

items.q: I run an agency and want to refer customers rather than sell myself.
items.a: Then our partner programme for companies is the better fit. You'll find it at nex-a-i.com/partner.
